fields.name: Author
fields.definition: Author name(s) of the study or paper. Extract from the author line near the main title, not from the abstract, introduction, or citations.

fields.name: Year
fields.definition: Publication year of the study or paper.

fields.name: Publication type
fields.definition: Type of publication. Must be exactly one of: 'journal articles' or 'dissertation'.

fields.name: Country
fields.definition: Where the study was conducted. If a country is stated, return the country name. If only a broad region is stated, return the stated region. Do not state specific parts of a country (e.g., say 'United States', not 'Midwestern US').

fields.name: Sample
fields.definition: Number of participants in each group, ordered [total, female, male]. If gender breakdown is not reported, return only [total].

fields.name: Survey method
fields.definition: Method used to collect data. One value per sample. If the description states evidence to infer this, do so but justify in inference_reason.

fields.name: Percent of white in participants
fields.definition: Percentage (0-100) of participants identifying as white or Caucasian. Usually a single total-sample value.

fields.name: Mean age of participants
fields.definition: Mean (average) age of participants in years. Usually a single total-sample value.

fields.name: Percentage of college or higher of participants
fields.definition: Percentage (0-100) of participants with college or higher education experience.

case_rules.infer_rule: If the text says participants were undergraduate/college students, you may infer 100%. Only when confident.

fields.name: Mean BMI of participants
fields.definition: Mean Body Mass Index, ordered [total, female, male]. If only female/male are reported, the total may be a sample-size-weighted mean (see skill).

fields.name: Source of sample
fields.definition: Where/how participants were recruited. One value per sample.

fields.name: Assessment of BA
fields.definition: Which Body Appreciation Scale version was used. One value per sample.

fields.name: Assessment of BMI
fields.definition: How BMI was assessed. One value per sample. Justify any inference in inference_reason.

fields.name: Correlation between body appreciation and BMI
fields.definition: Pearson r between Body Appreciation (BAS/BAS-2 total) and BMI, ordered [total, female, male]. Select ONLY Body Appreciation, not Functionality/Pride subscales.

fields.name: Number of studies
fields.definition: Count of distinct studies/experiments reported in this paper. Return an integer.
